note: All 108 families of slice algebra-a have a reference module (refs/algebra_a_1..5.py + algebra_a_util.py). All 108 are exhaustive: 33,435 released typed questions checked, 33,435 verified, 0 mismatch / form / incomplete / ambiguous / unsupported / refError. unsupported.json is empty ({}).

The exported choice questions carry only the keyed letter. The option texts shown to the learner (statement side) were exported separately with a small bun script (statement/options only, no solving code) to /tmp/certout/algebra-a/choiceopts/<family>.jsonl (above, accmpx, acfacts, affrule, ahvary, ajzchk, al3cons, alcons, alinf, almeth, alpoly, alqline); refs/algebra_a_5.py reads these files (path override: env ALGA_OPTS). Every option is evaluated independently as a mathematical statement (sign of the difference, rank test, sequence generated by each rule, procedure carried out step by step ...); exactly one option must be true and its letter must be the key. A reference never returns Expect(stored).

No generator solving code was read or imported. References derive answers from the prompt/figure text (parsed with regexes) by a different route than the obvious formula wherever practical: brute force (acbalance, acmissing, ahone, aecons, aelinw, aoarr, aocomm, acplace, aeineqz, ajfspl, ajfsq, alsplit, alsysx), SymPy division / factorisation / rank / roots (algebra), exact Fractions, the stdlib calendar module (aacalpat), numeric mpmath logs (aochb), polyline sign changes (alzgr), explicit enumeration of rotation/reflection classes (aoarr).

acsticks (row of n polygons sharing a stick: s + (n-1)(s-1), built by adding s-1 sticks per extra polygon); alglp mode 1 (LCM = product / GCD, exact polynomial division; the identity GCD x LCM = product is given in the statement); ahcomp, ahinv, ahman, ahwork (inverse/compound proportion and combined rate as exact Fractions - textbook definitions); aobinapp (first three binomial terms 1 + n d + C(n,2) d^2 as Fractions; mode 0 exact power by repeated multiplication). Each is a textbook identity or definition; the small cases were checked by hand.

Expect(form=True) is used where the prompt states a form: interval notation (aeineqs, aenbhd, aoabsin: unicode minus, ∞, ∪ exactly as written), inequality (aeineqw), simplified / expanded polynomials (ahlike, ahsub, ahthink, ahpyr, alcompx, alform, alpsq, aobinexp, aobinmid via refs.algebra_a_util.canon). All stored answers already satisfy these forms.

The drawn polyline (step 0.1, window |y| <= 5) is analysed: zeros = sign changes between consecutive vertices plus clusters of exactly-zero vertices (a tangent/double zero counts once). Cross-checked offline by fitting the polyline with a polynomial (degree <= 5, residual < 0.005) and counting distinct real roots: all 244 agree with the stored count (including cubics with a double root); no zero lies outside the drawn x-range.

Non-choice families are also checked by the runner for the multiple-choice presentation: 27,170 mc presentations checked, 0 with zero or several options equal to the derived answer or with the key on a wrong option.

20,452 word presentations: the runner confirmed answer equality with the typed form (0 differences). Wording was NOT verified for all; the word prompts of every family that has a word form were read (2 random questions per family, ~130 prompts in total) and each tells the same mathematical problem as the typed form with the stored answer as its solution. Cosmetic issues only (see register).

Figure consistency with the statement was checked by script for abmiss, abseq, aehund, acbalance, acmissing, acplace, acsticks, aapatn, aapatu, aaweave, ahcal, aepat (all consistent) and inside the references for aacalpat (equal to the real calendar), abpascal, affig, acgrow, afmatch, alrule, alqtab, agtree, ahvary, alzgr.

To show the references are not vacuous, one deliberately wrong answer was substituted for 60 evenly spaced questions per family (answer+1, extra element, last tuple component +1, next letter, "(expr)+1", altered interval bracket; 6,480 mutated questions). 0 passed as verified; 6,368 were mismatches and 112 interval mutations were unreadable (so also not verified). refError = 0. Mutated data and results: scratchpad only, not part of the deliverable.

natural numbers start at 1 (aeineqz, consistent with the statement and its word form "counting number 1, 2, 3, ..."); the polynomial degree of a multivariable term is the sum of exponents (alpdeg); "zeros" of a quadratic are real (no released alsym / ahzk question has a negative discriminant); a repeated zero is listed once for set-type answers; the "x cannot be more than 100" bound in aeineqw is applied together with x >= 0.
